headline: Texas Instruments authors report EEnet loading models for digital mixed-signal power verification
fact: A DVCon 2019 paper by Texas Instruments authors describes using a SystemVerilog user-defined EEnet to model voltage, current, and resistance loading in power-regulation verification. The UVM-based flow randomized supplies, loads, and system states, supported reusable DMS and AMS environments, and extended verification to loading effects that simple voltage-only real-number interfaces could not represent.

sources.title: Enabling Digital Mixed-Signal Verification of Loading Effects in Power Regulation Using a SystemVerilog User-Defined Nettype
sources.summary: The Texas Instruments paper defines the EEnet loading model and describes randomized, reusable UVM-based DMS and AMS power-regulation verification.
